name: weave
description: Work safely inside a Weave live collaboration session: a shared working tree, Tasks with advisory soft locks, explicit conflicts, and host-only Git publication, all driven through the weave CLI.

interface.longDescription: Weave keeps several local copies of one Git repository in sync in real time while a single authoritative host maintains the canonical state. These skills teach an agent the shared-working-tree model: check for an active session, describe intent with Tasks, resolve conflicts without ever writing Git conflict markers, and publish to Git through Weave. While a session is active Weave owns every Git-writing operation, and only the host coordinator builds the canonical commit.
defaultPrompt: Is a Weave session active in this repository?
Start a Weave Task for the change I am about to make.
Prepare and create a Weave Git publication.
